4f70e4cc-0798-4d02-8c93-e8c44b960e12.JobDescription:
Senior Manager - Design

Location: Bengaluru

About the Team

The Product Design team at Navi creates clear, intuitive experiences that put users first. We work end to end across research, interaction, and visual design to shape products that are simple, fast, and purposeful. Our approach is deeply data-driven, combining user insights and product analytics to continuously refine and improve the user experience.

About the Role

Navi is seeking a Senior Design Manager to lead and scale our growing design team. This is a critical leadership role for someone who is not just an expert in design, but an expert in building a team that is "ruthless" in its approach to problem-solving. Your core responsibility will be to lead a team of talented designers who are experts in taste, data, and problem-solving, and who act as a force for alignment across the company. You will be instrumental in fostering a culture of relentless pursuit of excellence and pushing for an incredibly high bar for what we ship. You will be responsible for the overall success and strategy of the design function, from defining the "why" to ensuring a high-quality outcome. The ideal candidate has a strong backbone to take a stand for what is right for the customer and the company , but also has a humble heart to listen and learn.

What We Expect From You

●Strategic Leaderships

○ Partner with senior leadership (Product, Engineering, Business) to define the

design vision and strategy for all charters, aligning with company goals and

product principles.

○ Champion a customer-first mindset, ensuring the team starts with the

customer's pain and obsesses over making their lives better.

○ Drive a culture of ruthless prioritization, ensuring the team is focused on doing

fewer things, but better.○ Seek clarity relentlessly to unblock your team and ensure everyone is moving

fast with purpose and sense.

●Team Leadership & Management:

○ Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of product designers,

fostering their growth and helping them do their best work.

○ Conduct performance reviews, set career goals, and create a clear path for

professional development for the team.

○ Instill the core Navi principles of end-to-end ownership and accountability.

●Design & Process Excellence:

○ Maintain and elevate an incredibly high bar for design quality, simplicity, and

taste across all products.

○ Oversee the design process, ensuring it is data-informed and focused on clear

outcomes.

○ Establish and evangelize best practices, design patterns, and standards

across the organization.

Must Haves

●7+ years of experience in product design, with a minimum of 2-3 years in a formal management or leadership role.

●A proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and leading high-performing design teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.

●A strategic portfolio that demonstrates how your leadership and design vision drove significant business impact and customer value.

●Deep domain expertise in fintech or a related industry.

●Expertise in user-centered design principles and methodologies.

●Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus at a senior leadership level.

About Navi

We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI.

Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started!

Our Culture

At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference.We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day.

If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

Submit referrals only through TurboHire to ensure accurate tracking. You can follow progress through the My Referrals tab. Any referral shared through other platforms will not be considered.

Why Navi

Culture & Values

Our culture is shaped by people who care about their work and each other, making Navi a place where work and fun go hand in hand.

Explore more

Career Growth

Your growth at Navi is yours to define. Choose your direction, take ownership, and build your own path.

Explore more

Benefits & Well-being

We believe people do great work when they feel good. Our benefits are designed to make that possible every day.

Explore more

A Letter From The Chairman

At Navi, we work on real, hard problems in financial services. We solve them by thinking from first principles and staying relentlessly customer-first.

Doing this well requires people who take ownership, think independently, and follow through from problem definition to execution. We value clarity of thought over experience, and outcomes over activity.

This is a high-agency environment. Navi backs people who show ownership. If you invest your time and effort here, you get the opportunity to do some of the most meaningful and high-impact work of your career.

— Sachin Bansal, Co-founder and Chairman

Values At Navi

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. It sets the cultural pillars that shape our behaviours.

Life At Navi

Life at Navi is fast-paced, collaborative and full of learning. Navi is a place where people take ownership, challenge themselves and grow through meaningful work every day.
